statement.zh: 三星堆与商为同一政体——学界争议模型，本条不升为定论。
statement.en: That Sanxingdui and Shang were the same polity is a contested scholarly model — not elevated to fact here.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: political identity relative to Shang remains open; keep in hypothesis column.

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only; density pass 3 (D-2026-10-12-2).
